title: The Day Trader's primary sensor is STALE
why: Rule 0 (the data check): MCD1 is STALE, so the Day Trader stands aside and its reading is STALE with the reason UPSTREAM_STALE:MCD1, no archetype, no zones. The Scalper's primary sensor is MCD2, which is fine: rule 3s gives a LONG, VALID, because MCD3 is unavailable too and cannot modify. One broken sensor spoils one trader type, not both.
